question: Should maintainers accept the bundled Fireworks Kimi default that sends session-affinity headers whenever OpenClaw has a cache or session value, and should the schema companion land in the same release window?
rationale: The code path is a focused repair, but changing default provider-facing headers and sequencing the strict custom-config schema are compatibility decisions that automation should not settle.

options.title: Accept Fireworks affinity default
options.body: Land this PR as the narrow transport and bundled-catalog fix, with the compatibility risk intentionally accepted for the two Fireworks Kimi rows.

options.title: Pair schema companion
options.body: Land or fold in #92359 with this change if custom provider configs must accept the same compat field in the same release window.

options.title: Delay bundled catalog opt-in
options.body: Keep the transport parity work but remove or defer the Fireworks manifest flags if maintainers do not want default provider-facing affinity headers yet.

recommendation.title: Accept Fireworks affinity default
recommendation.body: Land this PR as the narrow transport and bundled-catalog fix, with the compatibility risk intentionally accepted for the two Fireworks Kimi rows.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the strongest available owner signal for the active OpenAI-compatible transport and compat resolution path that gates this behavior.
